headline: Paul Christiano joins OpenAI's safety committee; DeepSeek opens V4.1-Flash
body: A calmer day with partial recovery. Loss-of-control researcher Paul Christiano joined the OpenAI Foundation board and its safety committee, a small boost to Alignment & Control that trimmed Conquerors and Zookeeper. DeepSeek's MIT-licensed V4.1-Flash release eased Power Concentration, helping Libertarian Utopia. But an Anthropic scenario in which labour's share of income falls from about 60% to 45% weighed on Shared Prosperity and Egalitarian Utopia, offset by Suno paying rightsholders under its new licensed model. Horizon Balance rose to -6.69; Descendants moved above Benevolent Dictator.
movers_note: Libertarian Utopia +0.2 from DeepSeek V4.1-Flash (+0.13) and Christiano's appointment (+0.07); Zookeeper -0.2 from the same two stories (-0.08, -0.07); Conquerors -0.1 from Christiano (-0.10).
